title: NetPlanLeaseContractDraft
description: Minimal lease contract data schema and specification for NetPlan hard-constraint evaluation (ODP-FR-NET-002, Decision D18, Work Package WP-32A).

StoreLeaseContract.description: Authoritative contract snapshot for an existing operating retail store.

lease_contract_id.description: De-identified or masked contract reference from CLM / ERP system.

lease_start_date.description: Effective start date of current lease term (YYYY-MM-DD).

lease_expiry_date.description: Contractual expiry date of current lease term (YYYY-MM-DD).

monthly_rent.description: Base monthly contractual rent in TWD.

deposit_amount.description: Security deposit held by landlord in TWD.

break_clause_allowed.description: Whether the lease agreement permits unilateral early termination before natural expiry.

break_notice_months.description: Mandatory advance written notice period in months required for early termination.

early_termination_penalty.description: Measured penalty / liquidated damages incurred upon early termination in TWD. Null indicates unmeasured / missing data (distinct from 0.0 measured zero penalty).

restoration_cost_estimate.description: Estimated site restoration / demolition / reinstatement expense in TWD. Null indicates unmeasured.

renewal_option_flag.description: Whether tenant holds contractual unilateral right of first refusal or lease renewal option.

renewal_notice_deadline_days.description: Days prior to lease_expiry_date by which renewal notice must be served.

rent_escalation_cap_rate.description: Contractual maximum percentage rent increase upon renewal (e.g. 0.05 for 5%).

landlord_consent_status.description: Formal consent status from landlord regarding store modifications, lease extension, or assignment.

alteration_permitted.description: Whether lease agreement and landlord permit structural / store-format improvements and major fitout.

source_system.description: Authoritative enterprise source system providing the snapshot.

CandidateSiteLeaseTerms.description: Authoritative commercial lease terms snapshot for a candidate expansion site.

candidate_site_id.description: Canonical candidate site identifier matching expansion domain models.

listing_id.description: Underlying listing record identifier matching expansion.listings.

available_from.description: Earliest date the site can be handed over to tenant for fitout / occupancy (YYYY-MM-DD).

available_to.description: Latest listing availability window end date before offer expiration (YYYY-MM-DD).

signing_deadline.description: Contractual deadline by which lease agreement must be executed with landlord (YYYY-MM-DD). Null indicates unmeasured / unbounded.

target_lease_term_years.description: Contractual commitment term in years requested by landlord or proposed in scenario.

expected_monthly_rent.description: Quoted base monthly rent in TWD.

security_deposit.description: Required security deposit in TWD (typically 2-3 months rent).

fitout_grace_days.description: Rent-free fitout grace period in days granted prior to rent commencement.

zoning_commercial_permitted.description: Whether urban zoning regulations and building license permit retail / commercial operations.

source_feed_id.description: Data ingestion pipeline or provider registry identifier.

LeaseAdmissibilityResult.description: Outcome of evaluating lease feasibility for a network planning action.

entity_id.description: Store ID or Candidate Site ID being evaluated.

action.description: Network planning action option under assessment.

fail_closed_triggered.description: True if action option is rejected due to missing / unmeasured lease contract data.

adjusted_budget_cost.description: Calculated total budget cost including measured early termination penalties, restoration, or double-rent overlap. Null if unmeasured.

overlap_window_days.description: Calculated overlapping lease duration in days for MOVE action (source lease exit vs candidate handover).

reason.description: Auditable diagnostic explanation justifying status and cost calculation.

evidence_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot reference binding input contract states.

admissibility_evaluations.reason: Site available_from (2026-11-01) and signing_deadline (2026-10-15) are within Q4 planning horizon; commercial zoning verified.
Lease naturally expires 2026-09-30; measured zero early termination penalty and zero restoration cost verified by landlord agreement.
Break clause is prohibited (break_clause_allowed=false) and early_termination_penalty is unmeasured (null); fail-closed rejection.
Dual-side move feasible: source early termination penalty TWD 240,000 + restoration TWD 150,000 + candidate deposit TWD 405,000 + overlap double rent (45 days) TWD 180,000 less grace offset.
